context: Evaluates correct implementation of the event types scheduling API from visionarias-client. Tests cover correct HTTP methods for each CRUD operation, proper use of PATCH for partial updates, JSON request body formatting, Bearer token authentication, and correct URL path construction with IDs.

checklist.name: GET for listEventTypes
checklist.description: listEventTypes sends a GET request to /api/event-types with Authorization: Bearer <token>

checklist.name: POST for createEventType
checklist.description: createEventType sends a POST request to /api/event-types with the data serialized as JSON and Content-Type: application/json

checklist.name: PATCH for updateEventType
checklist.description: updateEventType sends a PATCH request to /api/event-types/{id} with only the provided partial fields in the JSON body

checklist.name: DELETE for deleteEventType
checklist.description: deleteEventType sends a DELETE request to /api/event-types/{id} with Authorization: Bearer <token>

checklist.name: Bearer auth on all functions
checklist.description: All four functions include Authorization: Bearer <token> in the request headers when a token is provided
